swap.11 miles · 1,800 ft climb · Moderate. El: 6 miles · 1,600 ft climb · Moderate. A steep forest climb to a deep green lake in the Madison Range.
swap.This is the walk we send visitors on fir: A short, steep walk up a creek through old forest to one of the prettiest lakes near town. Swim if you're brave; the water stays cold all summer.

swap.Follow the creek past Grotto and Arch Fa: Cross the bridge and climb with Cascade Creek on your right
swap.Keep right at the junction with the Emer: Keep going when the trail steepens through the rock garden
swap.Climb the last switchbacks to the lake,: Walk the shore to the far end for lunch, and come back the same way

swap.11 miles · 1,800 ft climb · Moderate. El: 20 miles · 6,500 ft climb · Hard. The whole ridge above town, end to end, in one long day.
swap.This is the walk we send visitors on fir: The ridge you can see from every street in Bozeman. Walking all of it is a long, exposed day with a lot of up and down, and the views of the valley never stop.

swap.11 miles · 1,800 ft climb · Moderate. El: 6 miles · 1,700 ft climb · Easy to moderate. The after-work walk: a canyon trail to a view over the valley.
swap.This is the walk we send visitors on fir: Fifteen minutes from downtown, this is where we go on a weekday evening. A steady climb through a dry canyon ends at an overlook with the whole valley below.
swap.Start at the Hyalite Lake trailhead, at: Start at the Sypes Canyon trailhead at the end of Sypes Canyon Road
